notes: Task 7B source register for affix capacity and slot-consumption behavior.
Community evidence only; do not classify as official.

sources.factual_summary: Magic items can have a prefix and a suffix; rare items can have up to 3 prefixes and 3 suffixes.
Implicit, explicit, enchantment, corruption, and desecrated modifier categories are distinct; magic and rare capacity is described.
Desecrated modifiers take either a prefix or suffix modifier slot, even while unrevealed.
Crafted modifiers behave identically to other modifiers, except an item can have one crafted modifier.
